newsitem.title: UK: Heal's shares begin at premium in London.
newsitem.headline: Heal's shares begin at premium in London.

text.p: Shares in furniture retailer Heal's Plc were quoted at a premium to issue price on their market debut on Monday.
Heal's was quoted at 200p, ahead of the issue price of 175p. The company, which said it raised 14.3 million stg with its float, came to the market with a tag of 21.3 million stg at the issue price.
Heal's and two other companies - computer consultancy and services firm Diagonal Plc and car hire and repairs company Helphire Plc - joined the official list on Monday.
A fourth - leisure and sportswear supplier Prestbury Leisure - floated on the junior Alternative Investment Market (AIM).

By 1130 GMT Diagonal Plc's shares were quoted at 316p. They were issued at 275p in a placing raising 3.0 million stg of new money and valuing the company at 50.9 million stg, a spokesman for the company said.
Shares in Helphire Group Plc were quoted at 127-1/2p, with 1.9 million shares traded. The shares were issued at 100p in a placing by Williams de Broe, the company said.
Helphire raised 6.0 million stg before expenses with the issue, which valued the company at 16.3 million stg.
Shares in Monday's only new entrant to AIM, Prestbury Leisure Plc, were quoted at 2-3/4p, setting a premium to their 2p issue price, although no trade was recorded in the stock.
Prestbury said it raised 770,000 stg with a placing by broker Rowan Dartington valuing the company at 2.52 million stg.
